name: Attention Rail T2: title convention doc in spawn SKILL.md + titles at factory-init spawn steps

task_definition.title: Attention Rail T2: title convention doc in spawn SKILL.md + titles at factory-init spawn steps
task_definition.description:
Two doc edits establishing the terminal-title convention:

1. skills/spawn/SKILL.md — make the `terminal_title` argument (documented at :45) effectively required for programmatic callers, and document the convention `<role>:<project>#<task-id> <short-slug>` (e.g. `unblock:df#2085 routing-mechanism`, `prd:df attention-rail`). Update the Arguments and Invocation sections accordingly. Do NOT alter the positional contract or spawn-claude.sh behaviour — this is documentation of the existing title plumbing.
2. skills/factory-init/SKILL.md — the spawn steps (~lines 110-119, positional form `<cwd> <skip_perms> '<title>' '<prompt>'`) currently pass ad-hoc or empty titles; make each spawn (`/review-briefing`, `/review`, `/prd`) pass a convention-shaped title (e.g. `review-briefing:<proj>`, `review:<proj>`, `prd:<proj>`).

Pure doc edits over already-present title plumbing. This file group is disjoint from T1 (which edits escalation-watcher/SKILL.md) so the two run in parallel without lock contention.

PRD: plans/session-attention-rail-prd.md task T2 (+ capability-manifest.md T2).

User-observable signal: spawn SKILL.md documents the convention and marks title required for programmatic callers; factory-init spawn steps each pass a non-empty convention-shaped title.
Consumer: Leo-on-return (WM titles); future attention-manifest.
Modules touched: skills/spawn/SKILL.md, skills/factory-init/SKILL.md.
